title: PostgreSQL Upsert with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
code:
INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, theme, updated_at)
VALUES ('u_9281', 'dark', NOW())
ON CONFLICT (user_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  theme = EXCLUDED.theme,
  updated_at = NOW();
explanation: Atomically inserts a new record or performs an update if a unique constraint or primary key conflict exists on the target column, avoiding race conditions in concurrent write workloads.
caveat: The target column(s) inside ON CONFLICT must have a corresponding UNIQUE constraint or PRIMARY KEY index defined on the table schema.

variations.label: MySQL equivalent
variations.code: INSERT INTO ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE theme=VALUES(theme);
